snippet.title: Gallipoli - Reveal Trailer | Steam, PS5, Xbox Series X|S & Epic Games Store
snippet.description:
*For King and Country! Zafer Bizim Olacak!*

Gallipoli is a new authentic FPS game set on the Ottoman Fronts of WW1! Fight across battlefields ranging from Gallipoli to Lower Mesopotamia with realistic weaponry, historical classes and upgraded gameplay features.

Gallipoli releases in 2026 on Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Microsoft PC and Epic Games Store. 

Wishlist now on: 
Steam: https://r.ww1gameseries.com/?13GallipSteamAnnounceTrailer
PlayStation: https://r.ww1gameseries.com/?13GallipPSAnnounceTrailer
Epic Games Store: https://r.ww1gameseries.com/?13GallipEpicAnnounceTrailer

Read more about Gallipoli here: 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3065940/view/834973992999715448
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/WW1GameSeries/comments/1mtkgdh/attention_ready_up_for_the_middle_eastern_front/

Also, don't forget to like and subscribe to our YouTube channel!
